title: Transforming Education in South Sudan: Improving equitable access and learning outcomes for children (GPE-TESS). Programme Document for the Global Partnership for Education System Transformation Grant 2025-2029
publisher: Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of General Education and Instruction
why_not: Describes only the Annual Education Census and its donor financing (World Bank for 2025, the grant for 2026) and a planned EMIS harmonisation; no learner-record system, and the text was written before the twelve-month window.
